summary: HDFC Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing its Integrated Annual Report for FY 2025-26 and the notice of its 32nd Annual General Meeting scheduled for August 5, 2026, via videoconference. The filing is a routine regulatory announcement by a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change. It is an ordinary annual report and AGM notice, not triggering any special-situations classification. No deal terms apply.
